method: Manual visual transcription by Claude Opus 5.5, 2026-10-30, from work/hires/pc_hcp_33_adr.JPG rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise; enlarged 2-5x crops in work/crops/. No OCR.
key: Caesar: each plaintext letter written as the next letter (decrypt -1, A->Z)
heading_plain_not_enciphered: G. H. Friday (ordinary writing, underlined, not shifted). 1 Feb 1907 was a Friday; postmark Wimborne FE 1 07.
note: Each token is [as_seen, normalised]. as_seen is the sign shape on the card; normalised is what the Caesar key is applied to. They differ only at the points listed in SOLUTION.md. The g in as_seen means the closed-bowl, long-looped-descender sign, which occurs in nvdg and in jt.
